title: Flying Domestic in NZ with Kids — Air NZ Tips, Baggage, and Seat Selection
meta_desc: Flying domestic in NZ with kids? Tips on Air NZ family seating, baggage, and Queenstown routes from $59
intro: If you're planning a domestic flight with kids in New Zealand, you're likely considering Air NZ. With prices from $59 for a one-way ticket from Auckland to Wellington, it's an affordable option. But what are the best seats for families, and how much baggage can you check?

sections.heading: Air NZ Domestic Baggage Allowance
sections.body: Air NZ allows one carry-on bag and one checked bag per passenger on domestic flights. The checked bag must weigh under 23kg and measure under 158cm in total dimensions. Additional bags or oversized items incur a fee, starting at $20 for an extra bag.

sections.heading: Family Seating on Air NZ Domestic Flights
list: Book seats together in advance for $10-$30 per person
Choose seats near the front of the plane for less noise and disturbance
Consider booking a Skycouch for more space and comfort, from $100

sections.heading: Flying to Queenstown with Kids
sections.body: Queenstown is a popular destination for families, with activities like skiing, hiking, and visiting the Queenstown Gardens. Air NZ operates multiple daily flights from Auckland, Wellington, and Christchurch, with prices starting from $99 for a one-way ticket.

sections.heading: Tips for Flying with Kids on Air NZ
list: Book a morning flight to avoid delays and tired kids
Pack snacks and entertainment for the flight, such as colouring books and tablets
Consider booking a flight with an Air NZ Kids' Zone, featuring kids' entertainment and activities

sections.heading: Accommodation Options in Queenstown and Christchurch
sections.body: After arriving at your destination, you'll need to find accommodation that suits your family's needs. Queenstown has a range of options, from hotels like the Millennium Hotel Queenstown to holiday parks like the Queenstown Lakeview Holiday Park. In Christchurch, consider the Rydges Latimer Christchurch or the Christchurch Top 10 Holiday Resort. Check our destinations page for more information and booking links.
